counter_signal: Phenyl trimethicone and dimethiconol provide an affirmative retained conditioning-film signal, so the aqueous/volatile vehicle does not establish low.
The admitted glycol/water/volatile-carrier portion makes a secondary gum/film subsystem plausible; the declaration alone does not establish that the retained film is substantial.
Polyacrylamide is supported as part of the aqueous rheology triad and cannot be counted as independent substantial hair-conditioning film evidence.
The unreviewed ingredient functions cannot be assumed negligible from their ranks or supplied from general chemical knowledge.
current_property.reason: The phenyl-trimethicone/dimethiconol pair supports elevated as the nearest alternative, but B2 requires a substantial conditioning-film architecture rather than mere gum presence. Here the carrier/aqueous architecture and unspecified film grades/load leave that distinction unresolved, while the rheology polymer does not add qualifying support. B3 also fails because weak film and the complete retained system are not established. The unreviewed functions are material to closing the whole-system assessment, though they are not affirmative elevated evidence.
unresolved: PHENYL TRIMETHICONE rank 5 and DIMETHICONOL rank 6: grades, combined retained load and whether their conditioning film is substantial or secondary are unestablished; this is the decisive classification gap.

CAPRYLYL GLYCOL rank 8 has an admitted multifunctional-diol role with function not assessed; no conditioning-film or negligible-residue inference is supplied.
The rheology triad supports a functional interpretation without establishing exact supplier grade or dose.
Fragrance mixture contribution, final phase structure, finished film persistence and repeated-wash behavior are unspecified.
